_how_to_use: Paste each affiliate link into 'link'. Items with an empty link still show on the page, just without a button. 'retailer' is the shop name on the button (See it on Amazon). 'search' is a note for Rachel on what to pick, it is not shown on the site. Items with 'own': true are Rachel's own products: the button says buy_text with no sponsored tag, and the price line only shows once the link is filled.

sections.title: For your fittings
sections.intro: What you wear underneath changes the fit, so sort these out before your first fitting.

items.name: A low-back or strapless bra
items.why: Wear the bra you'll wear on the day to every fitting. If your dress has a low back, a stick-on backless bra or cups your seamstress sews into the dress are the usual fixes. Ask her which one suits your dress before you buy.
items.look_for: a plunge or low-back style in a shade close to your skin
items.search: stick on backless bra / plunge strapless bra, good reviews, AU sizing

items.name: Shapewear, if you plan to wear it
items.why: Shapewear changes your measurements. If you wear it to one fitting and not the next, your seamstress ends up taking the dress in twice. Decide early and bring it every time.
items.look_for: a seamless style that sits below the dress neckline and back
items.search: seamless bridal shapewear thigh slimmer, nude

sections.title: Getting it home and keeping it safe
sections.intro: Once your dress is ready, it might hang in a wardrobe for a week or more. These keep it clean and stop it stretching.

items.name: A wide gusset dress bag
items.why: Most garment bags are cut for a suit, so a full skirt gets squashed flat at the bottom. This white non-woven bag is 180cm long and 60cm wide, with a 35cm gusset at the base, so the skirt and train sit inside without crushing. The fabric breathes, so it won't trap moisture like plastic. It zips closed, with a hanger hole at the top and a holder for your slip. Use it to bring your dress home from the final fitting and keep it clean in the wardrobe until the morning. Posted from Toowoomba.
items.look_for: a gusseted bag with a wide base for full skirts

items.name: A padded hanger
items.why: A heavy gown on a wire hanger can pull at the shoulders. Hang the dress by the loops sewn inside the waist, with a padded hanger taking a little weight at the top.
items.look_for: a wide padded or velvet hanger with no metal edges

sections.title: On the morning
sections.intro: Small things that save a panic on the day. Hand them to a bridesmaid to look after.

items.name: A small handheld steamer
items.why: Your seamstress will usually steam or press the dress before you collect it. A handheld steamer is for the creases from the drive home or a night in the bag. Hold it a hand's width from the fabric and try it on the inside of the hem first. Leave beading and sequins alone.
items.look_for: a compact steamer that heats up fast and doesn't spit water
items.search: handheld garment steamer compact (Philips / Russell Hobbs), no spitting

items.name: Fashion tape and safety pins
items.why: Double-sided fashion tape holds a strap or neckline that wants to slip. A few small gold or silver safety pins fix a popped bustle hook until your bridesmaid can find a needle.
items.look_for: clear tape strips and small pins in a little tin
items.search: double sided fashion body tape + small safety pins

items.name: Heel protectors for a garden ceremony
items.why: Stilettos sink into grass. When a heel sinks you tip forward and can step on your own hem. Clear heel stoppers slip on and are hard to spot in photos.
items.look_for: clear stoppers that match your heel size

sections.title: After the wedding
sections.intro: Sugar and sweat marks can turn brown over time, even ones you can't see yet. Get the dress cleaned by a specialist first, then pack it away.

items.name: An acid-free preservation box
items.why: Store the clean dress folded in an acid-free box, somewhere dark and dry. A cupboard inside the house is better than the garage or under the bed.
items.look_for: a box sold as acid-free and lignin-free, big enough not to crush the skirt
items.search: wedding dress preservation box acid free kit

items.name: Acid-free tissue paper
items.why: Pad every fold with acid-free tissue so the fabric doesn't crease hard along one line. Take the dress out every year or two and refold it a different way.
items.search: acid free tissue paper unbuffered white archival
